Key Finding: One sampled user lacked complete manager approval evidence
Recommended Action: Require complete approval documentation before account provisioning
Validation Evidence: Access request tickets and manager approval records

Key Finding: Two terminated users retained active access beyond the expected disablement timeframe
Recommended Action: Automate termination notifications and monitor disablement completion
Validation Evidence: Termination records disablement logs and access removal tickets

Key Finding: Three privileged accounts lacked current business justification or recent review evidence
Recommended Action: Perform quarterly privileged-access reviews and remove unnecessary elevated permissions
Validation Evidence: Privileged account inventory review approvals and removal records

Key Finding: Two applicable privileged accounts were not enrolled in MFA and had no approved exception
Recommended Action: Enforce MFA for all applicable privileged accounts and document approved exceptions
Validation Evidence: MFA enrollment report and exception approvals

Key Finding: Two sampled access review decisions lacked documented follow-up showing unnecessary access was removed
Recommended Action: Require remediation evidence for every access-review exception
Validation Evidence: Access review reports and access removal records

Key Finding: One production change lacked complete testing evidence
Recommended Action: Require testing documentation before final change approval
Validation Evidence: Change tickets testing records and approvals

Key Finding: Two review periods lacked complete documentation showing security logs were analyzed
Recommended Action: Establish recurring log review documentation and retain investigation evidence
Validation Evidence: SIEM review records and incident tickets

Key Finding: Three high-risk vulnerabilities exceeded the defined remediation timeframe without documented risk acceptance
Recommended Action: Enforce remediation SLAs and require formal approval for exceptions
Validation Evidence: Vulnerability aging reports remediation tickets and risk acceptance records

Key Finding: One incident lacked complete escalation and closure documentation
Recommended Action: Require standardized incident documentation before closure
Validation Evidence: Incident tickets escalation records and incident reports

Key Finding: No current tabletop exercise was available to demonstrate recurring incident response testing
Recommended Action: Conduct an annual tabletop exercise and track lessons learned and corrective actions
Validation Evidence: Tabletop exercise report and corrective action tracker

Key Finding: Only two of four expected recent restoration tests had sufficient evidence
Recommended Action: Perform quarterly restoration testing and retain recovery results
Validation Evidence: Restore test reports backup logs and recovery records

Key Finding: Two high-risk vendors had outdated reassessment evidence
Recommended Action: Establish annual reassessment requirements for high-risk vendors and track overdue reviews
Validation Evidence: Vendor assessments questionnaires and reassessment records

Key Finding: One policy exceeded its scheduled review date
Recommended Action: Update overdue policy and implement review reminders
Validation Evidence: Policy documents approval records and revision history

Key Finding: Two open risks lacked complete treatment or approval documentation
Recommended Action: Require risk owners to document treatment decisions and management approval
Validation Evidence: Risk register treatment plans and approval records

Key Finding: Two prior findings were marked closed without sufficient validation evidence
Recommended Action: Require independent validation evidence and closure approval before findings are closed
Validation Evidence: Finding tracker validation records and closure approvals
